chapterInfo.content:
6
Asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ no awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ
1 # 1 Be 6.16, 18 Lewi mma ne: Gerson, Kehat ne Merari. 2Na Kehat mma ne: Amram, Yishar ne Hebron ne Usiel. 3#Eks 6.20; 23.25; 1 Be 6.50-53 Na Amram mma ne: Aaron, Mose ne Miriam. Na Aaron mma ne: Nadab, Abihu, Eleasa ne Itamar. 4Eleasa woo Pinehas. Pinehas woo Abisua, 5na Abisua woo Buki, na Buki woo Usi, 6na Usi woo Seraia, na Seraia woo Meraiot. 7Meraiot woo Amaria, na Amaria woo Ahitub, 8#2 Sa 8.17; 15.27, 36 na Ahitub woo Sadok, na Sadok woo Ahimaas, 9na Ahimaas woo Asaria, na Asaria woo Yohanan, 10na Yohanan woo Asaria. (Ɔno na ɔdii sɔfoɔ wɔ asɔredan a Salomo sii no Yerusalem no mu). 11Na Asaria woo Amaria, na Amaria woo Ahitub, 12na Ahitub woo Sadok, na Sadok woo Salum, 13#2 Ah 22.4 na Salum woo Hilkia, na Hilkia woo Asaria, 14#2 Ah 25.18; Esra 7.1; Neh 12.26 na Asaria woo Seraia, na Seraia woo Yehosadak. 15#2 Ah 25.21 Na Yehosadak deɛ, AWURADE maa Nebukadnessar so maa no bɛtuu Yuda ne Yerusalem kɔeɛ no, ɔkɔɔ bi.
Lewi asefoɔ
16 # 1 Be 6.1; Eks 6.16-19 Lewi mma: Gersom, Kehat ne Merari. 17Na yeinom ne Gersom mma din: Libni ne Simei. 18Na Kehat mma ne: Amram, Yishar, Hebron ne Usiel. 19Merari mma ne: Mahli ne Musi. Na yeinom ne Lewifoɔ mmusua, sɛdeɛ wɔn agyanom teɛ no: 20Gersom deɛ ne: Libni, Yahat, Sima, 21Yoa, Ido, Sera, ne Yeaterai. 22#Eks 6.24 Kehat deɛ ne: Aminadab, Kora, Asir, 23Elkana ne ne ba, Ebiasaf ne ne ba Asir, 24ne ba Tahat, ne ba Uriel, ne ba Usia ne ne ba Saulo. 25Na Elkana mma ne: Amasai ne Ahimot, 26ne ba Elkana, ne ba Elkana-sofai ne ne ba Nahat, 27#1 Sa 1.1 ne ba Eliab, ne ba Yeroham, ne ba Elkana. 28#1 Sa 8.2 Na Samuel mma ne: Abakan Yoel, ne Abiya deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu. 29Merari deɛ ne: Mahli, ne ba Libni, ne ba Simei, ne ba Usa, 30ne ba Sima, ne ba Hagia, ne ba Asaia.
Adwontofoɔ Heman, Asaf ne Etan
31Na yeinom ne wɔn a Dawid de sisii AWURADE fie dwontoɔ som soɔ, firi berɛ a adaka no nyaa ahomeeɛ no, 32na wɔyeyɛɛ dwom mu asomfo ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no tenabea no anim de kɔsii sɛ Salomo sii AWURADE fie no Yerusalem, na wɔgyinagyinaa wɔn afa wɔn som no mu. 33#1 Be 15.17 Na yeinom ne wɔn a wɔgyinaa hɔ ne wɔn mma no: Kehat mma no mu: Ɔdwontoni Heman, Yoel ba, Samuel ba, 34Elkana ba, Yeroham ba, Eliel ba, Yoa ba, 35Suf ba, Elkana ba, Mahat ba, Amasai ba, 36Elkana ba, Yoel ba, Asaria ba, Sefania ba, 37Tahat ba, Asir ba, Ebiasaf ba, Kora ba, 38Yishar ba, Kehat ba, Lewi ba, Israel ba, 39#1 Be 15.17 ne ne nua Asaf a ɔgyina ne nifa soɔ, Asaf, Berekia ba, Simea ba, 40Mikael ba, Baaseia ba, Malkia ba, 41Etni ba, Sera ba, Adaia ba, 42Etan ba, Simma ba, Simei ba, 43Yahat ba, Gersom ba, Lewi ba, 44#1 Be 15.17 ne wɔn nuanom Merari mma a wɔgyinagyina benkum soɔ: Etan, Kisi ba, Abdi ba, Maluk ba, 45Hasabia ba, Amasia ba, Hilkia ba, 46Amsi ba, Bani ba, Samer ba, 47Mahli ba, Musi ba, Merari ba, Lewi ba.
Asɔrefie som ho nhyehyɛɛ
48Na wɔn nuanom, Lewifoɔ no, wɔde wɔn maa Nyankopɔn fie tenabea no som nyinaa. 49#Eks 28.1; Lew 16 Na Aaron ne ne mma ne wɔn a wɔhye afɔdeɛ, ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia ne aduhwam hyeɛbukyia no soɔ, wɔyɛ kronkronbea adwuma no nyinaa, na wɔpata ma Israel sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn akoa Mose hyɛeɛ no ara. 50#1 Be 6.3-8 Na yeinom ne Aaron mma: Ne ba Eleasa, ne ba Pinehas, ne ba Abisua, 51ne ba Buki, ne ba Usi, ne ba Seraia, 52ne ba Meraiot, ne ba Amaria, ne ba Ahitub, 53ne ba Sadok, ne ba Ahimaas.
Lewifoɔ nkuro
54 # Yos 21 Na yeinom ne wɔn tenabea ahodoɔ sɛdeɛ wɔn nkuro a afasuo atwa ho ahyia no teɛ, wɔn ahyeɛ mu: Aaron mma, Kohatfoɔ abusua no nyaa wɔn ntonto kyɛfa, 55na wɔmaa wɔn Hebron, Yuda asase so ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase a ɛtwa ho hyia; 56na kuro no ho mfuo ne ɛho nkuraa no deɛ, wɔde maa Yefune ba Kaleb. 57Na wɔmaa Aaron mma, Yuda nkuro, dwanekɔbea kuro Hebron, Libna ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase, Yatir, Estemoa ne ɛho asase, 58Hilen ne ɛho asase, Debir ne ɛho asase, 59Asan ne ɛho asase ne Bet-semes ne ɛho asase. 60Na Benyamin abusuakuo mu nso: Geba ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase, Alemet ne ɛho asase ne Anatot ne ɛho asase. Wɔn nkuro nyinaa yɛ dummiɛnsa wɔn mmusua no mu.
61 # 1 Be 6.66-70 Na Kehat mma nkaeɛ, abusuakuo no abusua mu no, wɔde ntonto maa wɔn nkuro du firi Manase abusuakuo fa no mu. 62#1 Be 6.71-76 Na Gersom mma, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ no, wɔde Isakar abusuakuo ne Aser abusuakuo ne Naftali abusuakuo ne Manase abusuakuo a ɛwɔ Basan no mu nkuro dummiɛnsa maa wɔn. 63#1 Be 6.77-81 Merari mma, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ no, wɔde ntonto yii Ruben abusuakuo ne Gad abusuakuo ne Sebulon abusuakuo mu nkuro dummienu maa wɔn. 64Na Israelfoɔ no de nkuro no ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase memaa Lewifoɔ no, 65#1 Be 6.55-60 na wɔde ntonto yiyii Yuda mma abusuakuo ne Simeon mma abusuakuo ne Benyamin mma abusuakuo mu nkuro a wɔabobɔ din yi.
66Na Kehat mma mmusua no hyeɛ so nkuro wɔ Efraim abusuakuo mu, 67na wɔmaa wɔn nkuro, dwanekɔbea kuro Sekem ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase, Efraim bepɔ so ne Geser ne ɛho asase, 68Yokmeam ne ɛho asase, Bet-horon ne ɛho asase, 69Ayalon ne ɛho asase, ne Gat-Rimon ne ɛho asase; 70ne Manase abusuakuo fa no mu: Aner ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase ne Bileam ne ɛho asase wɔde maa Kehat mma a wɔkaeɛ no abusua.
71Na wɔde Golan a ɛwɔ Basan ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase, ne Astarot ne ɛho asase a ɛwɔ Manase abusuakuo fa no abusua mu no maa Gerson mma; 72ne Isakar abusuakuo mu: Kedes ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase, Daberat ne ɛho asase; 73Ramot ne ɛho asase ne Anem ne ɛho asase; 74ne Aser abusuakuo mu: Masal ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase ne Abdon ne ɛho asase, 75Hukok ne ɛho asase ne Rehob ne ɛho asase; 76ne Naftali abusuakuo mu: Kedes a ɛwɔ Galilea ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase ne Hamon ne ɛho asase ne Kiriataim ne ɛho asase. 77Na wɔde Rimono ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase, ne Tabor ne ɛho asase a ɛwɔ Sebulon abusuakuo mu no maa Merari mma nkaeɛ; 78ne Yordan, Yeriko agya nso, Yordan apueeɛ fam, Ruben abusuakuo mu: Beser wɔ ɛserɛ so ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase ne Yahsa ne ɛho asase 79ne Kedemot ne ɛho asase ne Mefaat ne ɛho asase. 80Ne Gad abusuakuo mu: Ramot a ɛwɔ Gilead ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase ne Mahanaim ne ɛho asase, 81ne Hesbon ne ɛho asase ne Yaser ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase.

Lewi mma ne: Gerson, Kehat ne Merari. Na Kehat mma ne: Amram, Yishar ne Hebron ne Usiel. Na Amram mma ne: Aaron, Mose ne Miriam. Na Aaron mma ne: Nadab, Abihu, Eleasa ne Itamar. Eleasa woo Pinehas. Pinehas woo Abisua, na Abisua woo Buki, na Buki woo Usi, na Usi woo Seraia, na Seraia woo Meraiot. Meraiot woo Amaria, na Amaria woo Ahitub, na Ahitub woo Sadok, na Sadok woo Ahimaas, na Ahimaas woo Asaria, na Asaria woo Yohanan, na Yohanan woo Asaria. (Ɔno na ɔdii sɔfoɔ wɔ asɔredan a Salomo sii no Yerusalem no mu). Na Asaria woo Amaria, na Amaria woo Ahitub, na Ahitub woo Sadok, na Sadok woo Salum, na Salum woo Hilkia, na Hilkia woo Asaria, na Asaria woo Seraia, na Seraia woo Yehosadak. Na Yehosadak deɛ, AWURADE maa Nebukadnessar so maa no bɛtuu Yuda ne Yerusalem kɔeɛ no, ɔkɔɔ bi.

Lewi mma: Gersom, Kehat ne Merari. Na yeinom ne Gersom mma din: Libni ne Simei. Na Kehat mma ne: Amram, Yishar, Hebron ne Usiel. Merari mma ne: Mahli ne Musi. Na yeinom ne Lewifoɔ mmusua, sɛdeɛ wɔn agyanom teɛ no: Gersom deɛ ne: Libni, Yahat, Sima, Yoa, Ido, Sera, ne Yeaterai. Kehat deɛ ne: Aminadab, Kora, Asir, Elkana ne ne ba, Ebiasaf ne ne ba Asir, ne ba Tahat, ne ba Uriel, ne ba Usia ne ne ba Saulo. Na Elkana mma ne: Amasai ne Ahimot, ne ba Elkana, ne ba Elkana-sofai ne ne ba Nahat, ne ba Eliab, ne ba Yeroham, ne ba Elkana. Na Samuel mma ne: Abakan Yoel, ne Abiya deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu. Merari deɛ ne: Mahli, ne ba Libni, ne ba Simei, ne ba Usa, ne ba Sima, ne ba Hagia, ne ba Asaia.

Na yeinom ne wɔn a Dawid de sisii AWURADE fie dwontoɔ som soɔ, firi berɛ a adaka no nyaa ahomeeɛ no, na wɔyeyɛɛ dwom mu asomfo ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no tenabea no anim de kɔsii sɛ Salomo sii AWURADE fie no Yerusalem, na wɔgyinagyinaa wɔn afa wɔn som no mu. Na yeinom ne wɔn a wɔgyinaa hɔ ne wɔn mma no: Kehat mma no mu: Ɔdwontoni Heman, Yoel ba, Samuel ba, Elkana ba, Yeroham ba, Eliel ba, Yoa ba, Suf ba, Elkana ba, Mahat ba, Amasai ba, Elkana ba, Yoel ba, Asaria ba, Sefania ba, Tahat ba, Asir ba, Ebiasaf ba, Kora ba, Yishar ba, Kehat ba, Lewi ba, Israel ba, ne ne nua Asaf a ɔgyina ne nifa soɔ, Asaf, Berekia ba, Simea ba, Mikael ba, Baaseia ba, Malkia ba, Etni ba, Sera ba, Adaia ba, Etan ba, Simma ba, Simei ba, Yahat ba, Gersom ba, Lewi ba, ne wɔn nuanom Merari mma a wɔgyinagyina benkum soɔ: Etan, Kisi ba, Abdi ba, Maluk ba, Hasabia ba, Amasia ba, Hilkia ba, Amsi ba, Bani ba, Samer ba, Mahli ba, Musi ba, Merari ba, Lewi ba.

Na wɔn nuanom, Lewifoɔ no, wɔde wɔn maa Nyankopɔn fie tenabea no som nyinaa. Na Aaron ne ne mma ne wɔn a wɔhye afɔdeɛ, ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia ne aduhwam hyeɛbukyia no soɔ, wɔyɛ kronkronbea adwuma no nyinaa, na wɔpata ma Israel sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn akoa Mose hyɛeɛ no ara. Na yeinom ne Aaron mma: Ne ba Eleasa, ne ba Pinehas, ne ba Abisua, ne ba Buki, ne ba Usi, ne ba Seraia, ne ba Meraiot, ne ba Amaria, ne ba Ahitub, ne ba Sadok, ne ba Ahimaas.

Na yeinom ne wɔn tenabea ahodoɔ sɛdeɛ wɔn nkuro a afasuo atwa ho ahyia no teɛ, wɔn ahyeɛ mu: Aaron mma, Kohatfoɔ abusua no nyaa wɔn ntonto kyɛfa, na wɔmaa wɔn Hebron, Yuda asase so ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase a ɛtwa ho hyia; na kuro no ho mfuo ne ɛho nkuraa no deɛ, wɔde maa Yefune ba Kaleb. Na wɔmaa Aaron mma, Yuda nkuro, dwanekɔbea kuro Hebron, Libna ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase, Yatir, Estemoa ne ɛho asase, Hilen ne ɛho asase, Debir ne ɛho asase, Asan ne ɛho asase ne Bet-semes ne ɛho asase. Na Benyamin abusuakuo mu nso: Geba ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase, Alemet ne ɛho asase ne Anatot ne ɛho asase. Wɔn nkuro nyinaa yɛ dummiɛnsa wɔn mmusua no mu.
Na Kehat mma nkaeɛ, abusuakuo no abusua mu no, wɔde ntonto maa wɔn nkuro du firi Manase abusuakuo fa no mu. Na Gersom mma, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ no, wɔde Isakar abusuakuo ne Aser abusuakuo ne Naftali abusuakuo ne Manase abusuakuo a ɛwɔ Basan no mu nkuro dummiɛnsa maa wɔn. Merari mma, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ no, wɔde ntonto yii Ruben abusuakuo ne Gad abusuakuo ne Sebulon abusuakuo mu nkuro dummienu maa wɔn. Na Israelfoɔ no de nkuro no ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase memaa Lewifoɔ no, na wɔde ntonto yiyii Yuda mma abusuakuo ne Simeon mma abusuakuo ne Benyamin mma abusuakuo mu nkuro a wɔabobɔ din yi.
Na Kehat mma mmusua no hyeɛ so nkuro wɔ Efraim abusuakuo mu, na wɔmaa wɔn nkuro, dwanekɔbea kuro Sekem ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase, Efraim bepɔ so ne Geser ne ɛho asase, Yokmeam ne ɛho asase, Bet-horon ne ɛho asase, Ayalon ne ɛho asase, ne Gat-Rimon ne ɛho asase; ne Manase abusuakuo fa no mu: Aner ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase ne Bileam ne ɛho asase wɔde maa Kehat mma a wɔkaeɛ no abusua.
Na wɔde Golan a ɛwɔ Basan ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase, ne Astarot ne ɛho asase a ɛwɔ Manase abusuakuo fa no abusua mu no maa Gerson mma; ne Isakar abusuakuo mu: Kedes ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase, Daberat ne ɛho asase; Ramot ne ɛho asase ne Anem ne ɛho asase; ne Aser abusuakuo mu: Masal ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase ne Abdon ne ɛho asase, Hukok ne ɛho asase ne Rehob ne ɛho asase; ne Naftali abusuakuo mu: Kedes a ɛwɔ Galilea ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase ne Hamon ne ɛho asase ne Kiriataim ne ɛho asase. Na wɔde Rimono ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase, ne Tabor ne ɛho asase a ɛwɔ Sebulon abusuakuo mu no maa Merari mma nkaeɛ; ne Yordan, Yeriko agya nso, Yordan apueeɛ fam, Ruben abusuakuo mu: Beser wɔ ɛserɛ so ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase ne Yahsa ne ɛho asase ne Kedemot ne ɛho asase ne Mefaat ne ɛho asase. Ne Gad abusuakuo mu: Ramot a ɛwɔ Gilead ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase ne Mahanaim ne ɛho asase, ne Hesbon ne ɛho asase ne Yaser ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
